title: Clutch Pedal Position (CPP) Switch
introduction:
For the 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT configuration, this procedure shows how the clutch pedal position switch comes out of its bracket and goes back in. The blue switch sits beside the pedal mechanism; the purple connector joins it to the wiring. The inset makes the bracket engagement easier to see.

I read this little assembly as a plug attached to a clipped-in part: disconnect the plug, then free the mounting. Keeping those jobs distinct makes the crowded pedal area less of a puzzle. Electrical diagnosis, switch adjustment and a functional test are outside the supplied instructions.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Before service, disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display: Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person starting the engine during service; an accidental start can cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Personal protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling components with pointed or sharp edges. Ignoring these precautions may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Clutch-system safety review
items.detail: Before starting, review the applicable precautions in [Brake and Clutch Systems Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693183), as required by [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189).

edits.text: NOTE: Review the removal steps when installing the switch, because they may include installation details.
edits.why: The removal instructions can carry information needed during refitting as well.

edits.text: Unplug the electrical connector from the CPP switch. Use the inset to locate the switch's retaining tabs where they engage the bracket openings. Free the tabs from the bracket and remove the switch.
edits.why: The full view identifies the wiring connection, while the inset isolates the mechanical retention. Releasing the bracket engagement allows the switch body to come away.

edits.text: Install in the reverse order: seat the switch in the bracket with its retaining tabs engaged, then reconnect the electrical connector.
edits.why: The bracket supports the switch before its wiring is reconnected. The supplied sequence ends with refitting and does not include a diagnostic confirmation.

referenceReview.reviewDisposition: Existing full independent technical review retained; deterministic source-bound startup clarification awaiting independent supervisory approval
